# Self-hosted vendor files

Taken from the official npm packages (`npm pack <name>@<version>`, integrity checked by npm). Do not edit.

| Package | Version | Files | License |
|---|---|---|---|
| bootstrap | 5.3.8 | `bootstrap.min.css`, `bootstrap.bundle.min.js` (sourceMappingURL lines removed — maps not shipped) | MIT (`LICENSE`) |
| bootstrap-icons | 1.13.1 | `icons.svg` sprite generated with only the icons the templates use | MIT (`LICENSE`) |
| pretendard | 1.3.9 | variable dynamic-subset CSS + 92 woff2 slices (browsers fetch only the slices a page needs) | SIL OFL 1.1 (declared in the package metadata; no LICENSE file in the package) |
